metadata.title: Notable UFO Cases
metadata.description: Famous and well-documented UFO sightings and encounters throughout history

cases.name: Roswell Incident
cases.summary: A rancher discovered mysterious debris on his property. The US Army initially announced recovery of a 'flying disc' before retracting the statement, claiming it was a weather balloon. Decades later, the Air Force admitted it was a Project Mogul balloon monitoring Soviet nuclear tests.
cases.witnesses: Mac Brazel, Jesse Marcel, numerous military personnel
cases.notability: Most famous UFO incident in history, sparked decades of conspiracy theories

cases.name: Kenneth Arnold Sighting
cases.summary: Private pilot Kenneth Arnold reported seeing nine unusual objects flying in formation near Mount Rainier at an estimated 1,200 mph. His description of their movement 'like saucers skipping on water' coined the term 'flying saucer.'
cases.notability: Launched the modern UFO era and coined 'flying saucer' terminology

cases.name: Phoenix Lights
cases.summary: Thousands of witnesses reported a massive V-shaped craft with lights spanning up to a mile, silently gliding over Phoenix. Governor Fife Symington initially mocked the sighting but later admitted he too saw the craft and couldn't explain it.
cases.notability: One of the largest mass UFO sightings in history

cases.name: Rendlesham Forest Incident
cases.summary: US Air Force personnel stationed at RAF Woodbridge reported encountering a triangular craft in Rendlesham Forest. Deputy Base Commander Lt. Col. Charles Halt recorded observations on audio tape and documented radiation readings at the landing site.
cases.witnesses: Lt. Col. Charles Halt, Sgt. Jim Penniston, Airman John Burroughs
cases.notability: Often called 'Britain's Roswell' - one of best-documented military UFO encounters

cases.name: USS Nimitz Encounter (Tic Tac)
cases.summary: Navy pilots from USS Nimitz encountered a white, Tic Tac-shaped object exhibiting extraordinary flight characteristics - no visible propulsion, sudden acceleration, and the ability to descend from 80,000 feet to sea level in seconds. Confirmed by Pentagon in 2017.
cases.witnesses: Commander David Fravor, Lt. Cmdr. Alex Dietrich, radar operators
cases.notability: First UFO videos officially released and confirmed by US Government

cases.name: Belgian UFO Wave
cases.summary: Over 13,500 people reported sightings of large, triangular UFOs with lights. Belgian Air Force scrambled F-16s which tracked the objects on radar. The objects demonstrated impossible acceleration - 0 to over 1,000 mph almost instantly.
cases.notability: Most thoroughly investigated UFO wave by a national military

cases.name: Ariel School Encounter
cases.summary: 62 schoolchildren reported seeing a silver craft land near their school and humanoid beings emerge. The children, interviewed separately, gave remarkably consistent accounts. Harvard psychiatrist John Mack investigated and found the children credible.
cases.classification: Close encounter of the third kind
cases.notability: Mass child witness event investigated by Harvard psychiatrist

cases.name: Tehran UFO Incident
cases.summary: Iranian Air Force jets were scrambled to intercept a brilliant object. When pilots attempted to fire, their weapons systems jammed. A smaller object detached and pursued one jet. Systems returned to normal when pilots disengaged.
cases.witnesses: Multiple Iranian Air Force pilots, ground control
cases.notability: Documented in US DIA report as 'classic case' meeting criteria for valid study

cases.name: O'Hare Airport Sighting
cases.summary: United Airlines employees observed a dark grey, metallic, disc-shaped object hovering over Gate C17. The object suddenly shot upward through the overcast clouds, leaving a visible hole. FAA declined to investigate, citing lack of radar evidence.
cases.notability: Major airport sighting with multiple credible aviation witnesses

cases.name: Westall UFO Encounter
cases.summary: Over 200 students and teachers at Westall High School witnessed a grey saucer-shaped object descend into a nearby field, then ascend and fly away. Some students claimed to see it land briefly. Military personnel allegedly arrived and warned witnesses not to discuss the event.
cases.notability: One of the largest mass school sightings in history

cases.name: Lonnie Zamora Incident
cases.summary: Police officer Lonnie Zamora witnessed an egg-shaped craft with two small beings in white coveralls near it. The craft had a red insignia and left behind burned brush and landing impressions. Project Blue Book classified it as 'unknown.'
cases.classification: Close encounter of the third kind
cases.notability: One of best-documented single-witness cases, investigated by Project Blue Book

cases.name: Washington D.C. UFO Incident
cases.summary: Over two consecutive weekends, UFOs were tracked on radar over the nation's capital. Air Force jets were scrambled but couldn't intercept the objects. The sightings prompted the largest Pentagon press conference since WWII.
cases.notability: UFOs over the White House prompted national security concerns

cases.name: Gimbal Video
cases.summary: Navy pilots recorded a rotating object traveling against 120-knot winds with no visible means of propulsion. Pilots exclaimed 'There's a whole fleet of them!' as multiple objects appeared on sensors. Released by Pentagon in 2017.
cases.notability: One of three official Pentagon-released UAP videos

cases.name: Stephenville Sightings
cases.summary: Dozens of witnesses including pilots and police officers reported a massive silent object with bright lights. Radar data later obtained through FOIA showed unknown objects in restricted airspace near President Bush's ranch.
cases.witnesses: Pilots, police officers, dozens of civilians
cases.notability: Radar data confirmed unknown objects in presidential restricted airspace

cases.name: Travis Walton Abduction
cases.summary: Logger Travis Walton allegedly approached a hovering disc and was struck by a beam of light. He disappeared for five days while six coworkers, who all passed polygraph tests, reported the event to authorities.
cases.witnesses: Travis Walton, six coworkers (all passed polygraphs)
cases.notability: Most famous alleged abduction case with multiple witnesses who passed polygraphs

cases.name: Falcon Lake Incident
cases.summary: Stefan Michalak approached a landed disc-shaped craft. When it departed, an exhaust vent burned a grid pattern into his chest. He suffered radiation sickness symptoms. The burn pattern matched the alleged vent configuration.
cases.notability: Physical evidence case - burns and radiation sickness documented by doctors

cases.name: Japan Airlines Flight 1628
cases.summary: Captain Kenju Terauchi and crew of a Boeing 747 cargo flight reported a massive walnut-shaped object twice the size of an aircraft carrier shadowing their plane for 50 minutes. FAA radar confirmed an object in the vicinity.
cases.notability: Well-documented pilot case with FAA radar confirmation

cases.name: Colares UFO Flap
cases.summary: Residents reported being attacked by beams of light from UFOs, leaving burn marks and puncture wounds. Brazilian Air Force launched Operation Saucer to investigate. Hundreds of photos and hours of film were allegedly collected.
cases.witnesses: Hundreds of residents, Brazilian Air Force personnel
cases.notability: Official military investigation with alleged physical effects on witnesses

cases.name: Kecksburg Incident
cases.summary: Witnesses reported a fireball streaking across the sky and a bronze acorn-shaped object crashing in the woods. Military personnel allegedly arrived and removed the object on a flatbed truck. Officials claimed nothing was found.
cases.notability: Often called 'Pennsylvania's Roswell'

cases.name: Levelland Case
cases.summary: Over 15 separate witnesses reported a glowing egg-shaped object that caused their vehicle engines and headlights to fail when it approached. Systems returned to normal after the object departed.
cases.notability: Multiple independent witnesses reporting identical electromagnetic effects

cases.name: Shag Harbour Incident
cases.summary: Multiple witnesses including RCMP officers saw a large lit object crash into the harbour. Coast Guard and divers found only yellow foam on the surface. Canadian government documents confirm the search operation.
cases.notability: Only UFO case officially documented by Canadian government

cases.name: Pascagoula Abduction
cases.summary: Charles Hickson and Calvin Parker claimed they were taken aboard a craft by robotic beings while fishing. When left alone by investigators with hidden recorders, they continued discussing the terrifying experience consistently.
cases.notability: Secret recording showed witnesses maintained story when alone

cases.name: Cash-Landrum Incident
cases.summary: Betty Cash, Vickie Landrum, and Colby Landrum encountered a diamond-shaped object surrounded by military helicopters. All three developed symptoms consistent with radiation exposure. Betty Cash was hospitalized and later died of cancer.
cases.witnesses: Betty Cash, Vickie Landrum, Colby Landrum
cases.notability: Medical documentation of radiation-like symptoms after UFO encounter

cases.name: USS Roosevelt Encounters
cases.summary: Navy pilots from USS Theodore Roosevelt reported near-daily encounters with unidentified objects over several months. Objects demonstrated advanced flight characteristics and appeared on multiple sensor systems. Led to new Navy UAP reporting guidelines.
cases.witnesses: Multiple Navy pilots including Lt. Ryan Graves
cases.notability: Led to Congressional hearings and new UAP reporting procedures
